subject: Taxes
title: Early Crypto Tax Chaos
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Early Crypto Tax Chaos.

hook.text: In 2013, a Bitcoin miner in Utah earned 1,000 BTC worth $100 each.

buildup.text: Was mining income taxed when coins were mined, or when sold? The IRS hadn't clarified. Miners guessed and hoped.

discovery.text: The IRS ruled that mined crypto is income at fair market value on the day received.

twist.text: If crypto's price crashes after mining, miners owe tax on value they never realized.

climax.text: Early crypto taxation was a minefield of unclear rules. Honest people made mistakes because no guidance existed.

punchline.text: Mined at $100, taxed at $100, crashed to $10. Miners owed tax on vanished value.

quiz.question: When does the IRS tax mined cryptocurrency?
options: At fair market value on the day received
